note: Triennial election of the sixteen district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Two divisions, Maze and Drumbo, were contested; thirteen members were returned unopposed and, with no nomination for Carryduff, its retiring member was deemed re-elected (returning officer's notice of result, Dromore Leader, 11 June 1949, p. 4; round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Glassdrumman' to Glasdrumman (19 Nov 2026, w19-merges, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official DED name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Hillsborough Rural District) and the NI DED maps of 1921-39 name the DED Glasdrumman; the rounds were filed as Glassdrumman (1924, 1949-64) and Glassdrummond (1927-46, 1967). This round was filed as 'Glassdrumman', the spelling of its source, kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (glassdrumman) answers with a redirect to this one.
